Not impaired; all artifacts relied on carry weight 1.0 (POL-GEN-02), so the confidence cap is 1.0 and POL-RD-10(1) does not fire. 4. Above de minimis 0.50; 4.60 / 22.32 = 20.6% < 90%, so PARTIAL_REFUND, not FULL_REFUND. 10. POL-GEN-05: 4.60 <= execution_threshold_sgd 8.00, so executed automatically, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. No-show clauses (POL-NS-01..12) are outside this category and do not apply.
doubts: Minor only. (a) Whether the driver's 'followed the navigation app' is an 'external traffic cause' within POL-RD-13; either way it cites no artifact and is discarded under POL-RD-08, so the outcome is identical - some readers may list POL-RD-13 among governing clauses. (b) The rider's request of 6.00 (based on an uncited 'usual' fare of ~16) exceeds the policy arithmetic; under POL-RD-02 the refund is fixed at 4.60, not discretionary. No alternative ruling is seriously supported: NO_ACTION would require an exculpatory clause with a cited artifact, and ESCALATE would require a POL-RD-10 trigger, neither of which exists on this record.
